snippet.title: Night Of The Idle Horde - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
